taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-30, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 74.2 | 15.31 | 15.31
2 | 27.3 | 18.79 | 34.10
3 | 76.3 | 5.06 | 39.16
4 | 96.3 | 4.07 | 43.23
5 | 138.1 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as K-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-30, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

Station T-30 in survey area T comprises five interpreted layers. The resistivity profile begins at 74.2 ohm-m, decreases to 27.3 ohm-m in the second layer, and then increases through the subsequent layers: 76.3 ohm-m (layer 3), 96.3 ohm-m (layer 4), and 138.1 ohm-m (layer 5). Based on these values, the sequence follows an HAA curve type. Please note that the classification of K-type currently on file is incorrect and does not match the interpreted resistivity model.

{"curve_type_stated": "HAA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
